_meta.note: Batch from 10 links. NEW model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B/6B hybrid-attn MoE, instruct scores). NEW benchmark AA Mobile Intelligence (on-device, iPhone 17 Pro) + E2E time, with 6 new small models (LFM2.5-2.6B/350M/230M, Nanbeige4.2-3B, Ornith-1.0-9B, G9v3-3B). AA GPQA Diamond net-new base models (7; existing bench already has 226). SKIPPED: Qwen3.8-Max blog (model already at 42 benches; competitor columns excluded per strict-attribution; net-new marginal); PAI-Bench arXiv 2512.01989 (older snapshot of the same SHI-Labs benchmark already populated from newer live HF leaderboard, config mismatch -> mis-attribution risk); NVIDIA PBench (WebFetch-summarizer scores, unverified + low DB coverage); NVIDIA simulation blog (no benchmark data). Qwen3.8-Flash-Next proxy-model ablation tables skipped (not the shipped model). Mobile reasoning/non-reasoning variants -> best per base model.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models._note: 125B total / 6B active sparse-MoE (512 experts, 10+1 active) + 51B n-gram embeddings + 4B MTP. Hybrid attention (3x Gated DeltaNet + 1x Qwen Sparse Attention per block). 262K ctx (ext. 1M). Reasoning model. qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.8-flash-next; tech report 'On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture' 2026-08-26.

models.name: LFM2.5-2.6B
models._note: On-device 2.6B; AA mobile benchmark. 2.3GB @4-bit on iPhone 17 Pro.

benchmarks.name: RecreationBench
benchmarks._note: Long-horizon application-recreation benchmark across desktop/mobile/web (introduced by Qwen3.8-Max blog).

benchmarks.name: AA Mobile Intelligence (on-device avg)
benchmarks._note: Artificial Analysis on-device benchmark: simple avg of BFCL/IFBench/AA-Omniscience/GPQA-Diamond/MATH-500, 4-bit quantized, <=8GB, iPhone 17 Pro @16K ctx. Higher better.

benchmarks.name: AA Mobile End-to-End Generation Time
benchmarks._note: AA on-device end-to-end generation time (1024-tok prompt + 256-tok response) on iPhone 17 Pro. Lower better.
